description:
Create a new Vercel deployment or redeploy an existing one.

Can create deployments from a git source or by redeploying a previous deployment ID. Returns the newly created deployment with its ID, URL, and initial state.

**Example response:**
```json
{
  "uid": "dpl_new789",
  "name": "my-app",
  "url": "my-app-new789.vercel.app",
  "state": "BUILDING",
  "target": "production",
  "created": 1700000000000
}
```

**Use cases:**
- Redeploy a previous deployment to the same or different target
- Trigger a new deployment from a specific git branch
- Create a preview deployment for testing
- Deploy to production after verifying a preview

deploymentId.description: ID of a previous deployment to redeploy. The new deployment will use the same source. Example: "dpl_abc123"

gitRef.description: Git branch or tag to deploy from. Example: "main", "feature/new-ui"

gitRepoId.description: Git repository ID (from Vercel project settings). Required when using gitRef.

gitType.description: Git provider type. Options: "github", "gitlab", "bitbucket". Required when using gitRef.

name.description: The project name for the deployment (used in the deployment URL). Example: "my-app"

target.description: Deployment target environment. Options: "production", "preview", "staging". Default: "preview" if not specified.

name: create_deployment
